summary: Backend-only verification of UnoWord (1) persistent-auth cookies and refresh flow, and (2) Website Links private-document feature. Added /app/backend/tests/test_links_and_auth.py (16 tests) run against the public preview URL https://uno-word-build.preview.emergentagent.com — ALL PASS. Covered: login sets both uno_session (path=/) and uno_refresh (path=/api/auth) httpOnly+Secure cookies; POST /auth/refresh with ONLY the refresh cookie returns 200 authenticated:true and a fresh uno_session (transparent access-token refresh); POST /auth/refresh with no cookie returns 401; GET /auth/me returns plan='pro', ai_access=true for seeded User A; POST /auth/logout returns 204 and emits Set-Cookie clearing both cookies. Links SSRF: all 7 payloads (localhost, 127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254 metadata, 192.168.0.1, 10.0.0.5, file://, ftp://) rejected with 400 before any fetch. Links auth: GET/POST /api/links → 401 without bearer. Links CRUD: POST https://example.com/ returns 201 with source_kind='link', enabled=true, processing_status in {ready,failed}; appears in /links; absent from /documents; PATCH enabled=false+category persists; POST /links/{id}/refresh keeps the same id (no duplicate) and the disabled flag persists after refresh. Dedupe: 2nd POST same URL → 409. Cross-user isolation: User B gets 404 on PATCH/refresh/DELETE of A's link and does not see it in GET /links. Final cleanup pass deletes every leftover link on both accounts — both test inboxes are now clean.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/auth.py refresh_session: inner `from fastapi import HTTPException` shadows the top-level import that is already available — unnecessary, remove the local import.
routers/links.py _reprocess returns None in the SupabaseAPIError branch after raise_http (raise_http does raise, so dead-code path is fine, but mypy/typing would complain). Minor.

routers/auth.py logout: response.delete_cookie uses samesite='none', secure=True — good for cross-site extension usage. Consider also deleting with path='/' AND path='/api/auth' explicitly to ensure both are cleared across all browsers; current path pair is correct but worth a comment.

SSRF guard in lib/link_ingest.validate_url correctly rejects non-http(s) schemes before DNS; _check_host_not_internal distinguishes 'blocked' (private/metadata/loopback/link-local/reserved) from 'unreachable' (DNS failure) and only hard-fails on 'blocked'. Good defense in depth.
Links dedupe uses user_id+source_kind=link+source_url=normalized; this correctly scopes dedupe per-user (User B can still save the same URL). Verified.

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Links created during tests (https://example.com/, https://example.org/) were deleted in test teardown AND a final catch-all test_zz_cleanup_any_leftover_links sweeps both accounts clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL honors Secure+SameSite=None cookies, so cookie-based auth tests must run there (not http://localhost which drops Secure cookies). Existing /app/backend/tests/test_links.py uses localhost+bearer and still works but doesn't exercise the refresh-cookie-only path. The new test_links_and_auth.py supersedes it for end-to-end verification. OpenAI embeddings succeed on example.com/example.org — processing_status came back 'ready', not 'failed'.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Persistent-auth refresh flow and Website Links feature are both working as specified.
